BHV-009.text: Data shared between screens: Order, Booking, Listing, Invoice, Payment, Delivery, Customer, Driver. A screen refreshes what it shows when it opens and after an action that changes it.

BHV-S001.text: A session is kept in secure device storage, renewed quietly before it expires, and an expired session sends the user to sign in again with their place and unsent work kept. Roles can differ: Role 1.1, Role 1.2, Role 1.3, Role 1.4, Role 1.5, Role 1.6. A session that expires while work is unsent keeps that work and asks the person to sign in again.

BHV-S002.text: Without a network the last saved data is shown as stale, actions that need the network say so, and queued actions are sent in order when the network returns. Data shown while offline is marked as saved earlier; actions that need the network say so and are queued only where a screen says they may be.

BHV-S003.text: Errors are sorted into network, server, validation, permission and unexpected; each says what happened in plain words and offers retry, correction or a way out.

BHV-S004.text: Every wait that lasts more than a moment shows that content is coming; a wait that passes the timeout becomes an error with retry.

BHV-S005.text: When the app returns from the background it restores the user's place and unsent input, and refreshes data that has gone stale.

BHV-S006.text: A missing or slow picture shows its fallback and never moves the content around it; uploads can be retried and resumed.
